messages:
mara_sales: Heads-up: LumiPay (POC scheduled next Tue) asked for a contract-level statement that no customer data leaves the EU during the 30-day POC. also wants subprocessors list and a quick cost delta if we must guarantee it.

eli_presales: short: hosted can do EU affinity + tenant pinning for the POC window but it's a soft guarantee. Dedicated/Private needed for contractual "no cross-border" guarantee. call out monitoring/logs and backups as typical egress.

nina_security: we can produce a vendor attestation and full subprocessors export. legal will require SLA language, audit rights, and likely BYOK if they demand an absolute guarantee. hosted = risk.

oscar_ops: ops note: we can spin a pinned tenant in eu-west-1 and switch telemetry to EU endpoints for the POC. backups can be restricted for the window. caveat: autoscale/burst can overflow if capacity not reserved -> potential fallback to nearest region. For absolute guarantee reserve Dedicated capacity or run Private.

eli_presales: suggested scoping sentence for the customer: "During the POC we will process and store data in EU regions. Hosted accounts will have EU affinity; backups and third-party telemetry may be processed outside EU unless Dedicated or Private deployment is chosen."

nina_security: add: "We will provide a subprocessors list and completed vendor attestations for the POC period." Flag: if customer insists on contractual EU-only processing, escalate to legal for BYOK and audit clause — this often adds negotiation time.

mara_sales: customer also asked for a ballpark uplift for Dedicated for 15 seats, 30-day POC. any quick numbers?

oscar_ops: rough: Dedicated uplift ~25-35% over hosted for short-term reservation, depends on GPU sizing and burst headroom. also enforce minimum monthly commit which might apply.

infra_bot: export ready: s3://exports/lumipay_poc/subprocessors_2026-03-22.csv (contains vendor contact, region endpoints, SCC refs).

mara_sales: perfect. I'll attach infra export to the scoping doc and ask legal for draft attestation and BYOK wording. will check if LumiPay accepts hosted-affinity or insists on Dedicated.

nina_security: FYI: if they want BYOK but remain hosted, key custody and HSM controls are sticky; recommend Private for full control.

eli_presales: also include a short burst policy in the scoping doc: reserved headroom to avoid cross-region fallback unless customer requests no-fallback (requires Dedicated).

mara_sales: will do. ETA EOD. closing loop once scoping doc and pricing draft posted. :thumbsup:
